title: Oseberg burial — two women, uncertain identities
description: Tests person/event correlation where biological identity is supported but social identity and ritual role remain unresolved.

support: Museum documentation identifies skeletal remains from two women in the Oseberg grave, one older and one younger.
counterevidence: The exact historical identities, status, relationship, and roles of the women remain debated or unknown.
alternative_explanations: ritual or household relationship not recoverable from current evidence
edges.notes: The edge supports the existence of two female persons connected to the burial, not a named historical identity.

support: Unresolved personal identities limit strong claims about specific ritual or political roles.
counterevidence: Rich burial context can still support broader statements about status and funerary significance.
edges.notes: Unknown identity is represented as uncertainty rather than filled with a preferred story.
